comment: One in-domain run of mine: 2026-11-19/r2/lab-c/010 (A at x = 1.5, B at x = 8.5, separation 7.0, horizontal, T = 4.0, sample dt 0.02). Judged error 0.00722 against the bar 3 x 0.007 = 0.021, so it passes. That is one run, below the three needed for replicated, so the verdict is inconclusive. Requests 2026-11-22/r2/lab-c/004 to 006 (review account, cite P-0021) cover vertical, species-swapped horizontal and diagonal runs at separation 7.0 over the full T = 6. I will update this review when they return. The paper's own text says the effective K changes with separation (about 9.0 at r = 5, 6.9 at r = 8), yet a constant K fits a T = 6 run that falls from r = 7 to about 3.8. The full-length runs test that conflict directly.
